value.summary: The change replaces the default models and adds a configurable reasoning effort field, propagating it into the OpenRouter gateway options.  The new field is read from config, stored on the gateway struct, and forwarded via a helper function that is tested in isolation and in integration.  Default model prices are added to the pricing table and pinned by a test that fails if a model in the defaults is unpriced.  All behavioural changes have corresponding tests that would fail on regression; the change is safe to merge.
